# SHRM - Society for Human Resource Management

> SHRM is the voice of HR professionals and the world's largest HR association with 325,000+ members, offering certifications, enterprise solutions, educational programs, and inclusive workplace initiatives.

SHRM serves as the central hub for HR professionals globally, providing industry-leading certifications (SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP), membership programs across all career levels, enterprise business solutions for Fortune 500 companies, and educational resources. The organization also operates the SHRM Foundation to advance diversity and inclusive workplaces.

## Key Topics

- SHRM-CP Certification
- SHRM-SCP Certification
- HR Professional Development
- Corporate Membership
- SHRM Foundation
- SHRM26 Conference
- People Manager Qualification
- HR Networking
- Workforce Management
- HR Leadership
- Career Advancement
- SHRM Connect
- HR Compliance
- Talent Management
- Inclusive Workplace

## Membership Programs

- [Join SHRM To Unlock Exclusive HR Resources and Networking](https://www.shrm.org/membership): SHRM membership overview with networking, professional development, and HR resources
- [HR Professional](https://www.shrm.org/membership/hr-professional): HR Professional membership plan with certification, compliance support, and networking
- [Executive Membership](https://www.shrm.org/membership/executive-membership): Exclusive executive membership for senior HR leaders with advanced resources
- [Corporate Membership](https://www.shrm.org/membership/enterprise): Corporate membership bringing SHRM insights to entire organizational teams
- [Student SHRM Membership | Pursue Your Purpose](https://www.shrm.org/membership/students): Student membership offering mentorship, scholarships, and 30k+ HR professional network
- [Global](https://www.shrm.org/membership/global): Global membership for international HR professionals with cross-cultural resources

## Certifications & Credentials

- [SHRM HR Certification | SHRM-CP & SHRM-SCP](https://www.shrm.org/credentials/certification): SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP certification programs with BASK competency framework
- [Choosing the Right HR Certification | SHRM](https://www.shrm.org/credentials/certification/which-shrm-certification): Guide comparing SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP certifications with eligibility requirements

## Education & Training

- [SHRM Educational Programs](https://www.shrm.org/events-education/education): Self-paced online and in-person HR training courses with expert instruction

## Enterprise Solutions

- [SHRM Enterprise Business Solutions](https://www.shrm.org/enterprise-solutions): Enterprise solutions for Fortune 500 companies with PMQ+ training and talent management

## Foundation & Community

- [SHRM Foundation - Building an Inclusive World of Work](https://www.shrm.org/foundation): SHRM Foundation nonprofit advancing inclusive workplaces and diversity initiatives

## Core Resources

- [SHRM Home - The Voice of All Things Work](https://www.shrm.org/home): SHRM homepage showcasing 325k-member HR association with certifications and events
- [Dashboard](https://www.shrm.org/shop/dashboard): Member dashboard for SHRM26 conference, events, and certification resources
